item.title: Soma 1.0 (600)
item.description:
Soma 1.0 (600)

  • The people picker has People, Teams and Groups tabs, and you can add a team anywhere you add people.
  • A person’s page now shows the work of the groups they’re in.
  • Added appearance styles: 11 light and 10 dark, each with its own accent colour, including Soft White and Soft Dusk.

Soma is still in beta testing. Keep backups on (Settings › Backups).
